blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Davao City Rep. Paolo “Pulong” Duterte on Saturday questioned the necessity of his testimony to “shed light” on the claims by a dismissed policeman that suitcases were delivered to him and his relatives. If Rodulfo Gracioso, Jr. passed a lie detector test regarding his cash delivery claims, then there should be no need to summon him, Duterte said in a Facebook post, noting that investigators already consider the accuser’s polygraph results as truthful. “So Gracioso is 99.9 percent legit based on the NBI’s (National Bureau of Investigation) lie detector test, right? Well if you’re that confident in him, […]... Keep on reading: Paolo Duterte questions need to testify on alleged cash deliveries
